page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Continuous text from the previous page, then a rule, then centred division heading, subtitle and italic "Analysis." heading, then a paragraph with drop cap running to the foot. No marginal notes. Catchword at the bottom right, gathering signature at the bottom left.

main_text.p: do cohibuisse : sicut etiam nonnullæ potestatem ejus ecclesiasticam ferè enervarunt ; his illi infallibilitatem detrahentibus, aliis investituram Episcoporum, Abbatum, aliorumque Prælatorum, Regibus & Principibus ex postliminio denuò adjudicantibus. Imò res nunc mediante doctrinâ Reformatâ eo rediit, ut eruditiores in papatu hodiè longè aliter de multis dogmatibus statuant & loquantur, quàm olim ; & cogantur pigmenta quærere, quibus errores pontificios obtegant. Un-dè tamen effectum est, ut damna, isti civitati illata, quomodocunque se res mundi vertant, refarciri nequeant : nihilque superfit, quàm decretum à Deo, & multis quoque vaticiniis firmatum, subversionis judicium, quod verbo Dei credentes exspectamus.
main_text.head: SUBSECTIO QUINTA

head.i: De Callidis & violentis piorum aliorumque circumventoribus & eorundem judicio.

main_text.p: PRoximè[?] à civitatis cujusdam, & conditoris ejusdem judicio, sequitur aliorum studium damnatum, quo verè credentes, aut saltem fidem gloriæ Domini profitentes fascinante quasi poculo inebriare, & ita circumvenire laborabant, quò ad scortationem spiritualem cum ipsis transeant. Hoc eorum studium in hac visione concipitur, ut cum successu inceptum & promotum, donec Deus, justus

page.notes: The initial letter is an ornate capital, read as P; the first word is printed "Roximè" with the drop cap joined, so it is marked [?]. A dark ornamental mark stands beside "Un-" at the end of the first paragraph; it is not text. A horizontal rule separates the first paragraph from the division heading. The line "Un-dè" carries its printed hyphen at the line end. Long s has been transcribed as plain s throughout, and the i/j and u/v conventions have been applied.
